$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. LoopPackageSignature = the detached record under a .floop package's signatures/ directory (floop-container-format.v1.json requiredTopLevelLayout). Signature suite is Ed25519 over the release-identity tuple, per canonicalization.v1.json's fb-loop-canon-1 profile (the bytes signed are the JCS-canonicalized releaseIdentity object below, forbidding IEEE-754 doubles like every other canonical payload in this corpus) and LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11 (FB-RAT-PKG-005): 'A release signature MUST bind exactly: loopId, semanticVersion, packageContentDigest, canonicalizationVersion, the publisher's key fingerprint, and the release channel.'
title: LoopPackageSignature
description: loop-package-signature.v1 — an Ed25519 detached signature over a LoopPackage release identity. keyProvenance distinguishes a phone Keystore/StrongBox-signed publisher key from the browser-side soft-key unlisted-draft tier (LOOP_WEB_STUDIO_SPEC.md §13's phone-signing correction — WebAuthn cannot produce a detached signature over an arbitrary caller-supplied digest, so publisher signing for marketplace publication happens on the phone; a soft key is a lower-trust, unlisted-drafts-only tier that MUST NOT be presented as equivalent).

signatureAlgorithm.description: The only signature suite this corpus defines (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11, 10_DUAL_VALIDATION_ADDENDUM.md §D). A future suite requires a new schema major, not a widened enum here — signature-suite ambiguity is exactly the kind of thing a verifier must never guess at.

publisherKeyFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the publisher's Ed25519 public key, lowercase hex. Bound into the signature per LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11's 'MUST bind exactly' list; also the key-rotation/revocation lookup key (a revoked key MUST NOT retroactively alter bytes already installed locally, but every installation surface MUST show revocation status before any NEW activation under a revoked key).

signedDigest.description: The raw Ed25519 signature bytes (64 bytes), base64-encoded — NOT itself a digest despite the field name inherited from this work package's task brief; it is the signature computed over the fb-loop-canon-1-canonicalized bytes of the `releaseIdentity` object below plus the four other bound elements (canonicalizationVersion, publisherKeyFingerprint, releaseChannel).

releaseIdentity.description: The {loopId, semanticVersion, packageContentDigest} tuple LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1.md §14 defines a release's identity as ('A release is identified by {loopId, semanticVersion, packageDigest, publisherKeyFingerprint}' — publisherKeyFingerprint is carried as this object's own sibling field above rather than duplicated inside the tuple, since it is bound to the signature independently per LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11).

canonicalizationVersion.description: Matches canonicalization.v1.json's own canonicalizationVersion value. Bound into the signature per LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11 so a future canonicalization-profile bump can never be silently substituted under an old signature.

releaseChannel.description: The distribution channel this specific signature is bound to (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11: signature MUST bind 'the release channel'). Modeled as a non-empty string, not an enum — the closed channel vocabulary is owned by LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md's listing/release model, not re-derived or invented in this schema-authoring pass.

signedAtUtc.description: UTC instant the signature was produced (FB-RAT-COM-004).

keyProvenance.description: PHONE_KEYSTORE: signed on-device with an Android Keystore/StrongBox-backed Ed25519 key via the phone's existing activation-import path (LOOP_WEB_STUDIO_SPEC.md §13's PUBLISHER_SIGNED state) — the only tier eligible for marketplace publication. SOFT_KEY: a non-extractable browser IndexedDB CryptoKey, explicitly a lower-trust tier scoped to unlisted, account-free drafts only (FB-RAT-WEB-009, EXPERIMENTAL) — MUST NOT be presented as equivalent to a phone-signed signature and MUST NOT be accepted for direct marketplace publication (LOOP_WEB_STUDIO_SPEC.md §13's REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_SIGNATURE transition).

softKeyScope.description: Structural guard for the SOFT_KEY tier: required to equal 'UNLISTED_DRAFT_ONLY' whenever keyProvenance is SOFT_KEY, so a soft-signed record is self-declaring its own restriction rather than relying on a downstream reader to remember the rule. MUST be null when keyProvenance is PHONE_KEYSTORE.
